votes.motion: Motion to accept the LA4 as presented

what_happened.line: The board voted to accept the LA4 assessment-to-sales ratio report, a step toward setting the FY26 tax rate.
The new-growth figure used for the LA13 report was corrected downward after duplicate entries were found in the state's Gateway system.
The principal assessor was asked to bring back a methodology for spreading the new senior means-tested exemption's tax shift onto other taxpayers.
The board will seek a joint meeting with the select board to consider appointing a new assessor board member.
Review of Clause 18 and a possible GIS vendor change was pushed from November 19 to the December 3 meeting.

why_it_matters: The LA4 report and the corrected new-growth figure are inputs to how the FY26 tax rate gets set, which affects every property tax bill in town.

The senior means-tested exemption removes tax burden from approved applicants and shifts it onto everyone else; how that shift is calculated is still being worked out and returns to the board on November 19.
The November 25 classification hearing is where the select board decides whether residential and commercial property are taxed at the same or different rates.
